about_pullquote: We treat every tree like it's been in someone's garden for twenty years.
about_para_1: Pine and Dandy Tree Services started over 15 years ago when our founder got fed up watching Manchester gardens neglected by cowboys with chainsaws. We're NPTC-qualified arborists who live and work locally. Every job gets the same attention: careful site assessment, proper equipment, and respect for the neighbours.
about_para_2: We've built our reputation on honesty. We'll tell you if a tree can be saved, and we won't sell you unnecessary work. Customers come back because we're reliable, tidy, and leave your garden better than we found it. We're insured, fully certified, and proud to be Manchester's go-to tree surgeon.
reviews_heading: What Manchester Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a massive oak that was leaning over the garage. Called Pine and Dandy on the Monday, they came Wednesday morning and felled it safely. Cleaned up all the mess and chipped the branches. Professional, tidy, and the price was fair. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: David P.

reviews.text: Emergency call-out after the storm. A branch had brought down the power line and was hanging over next door's roof. They arrived within two hours, removed it safely, and even helped clear the garden afterwards. Absolute lifesaver. Worth every penny.
reviews.author: Helen T.

reviews.text: Been using these guys for three years now. Hedge trim twice a year, and they're always punctual, polite, and tidy. No hard sell, no fancy jargon—just solid, honest work. That's rare these days.
reviews.author: Michael J.
